properties.description: Pins req:the-reasoning-read-back-keeps-the-words-of-the-claims-it-returns on proof trial rung 2's design. At the default budget every returned claim is whole: its `says`, each step's rule and warrant, each premise's name, and no text cut. The pages, read on with next_offset, return every claim of the walk once, in the order an unbounded read gives. At flo2.io's 27,267 the page names the budget_chars it was held to, and the claims are still whole. A one-claim page still lists the foundations in rests_on and stated_foundations.
properties.name: a_reasoning_read_back_keeps_its_words_and_pages.rs — whole claims, paging in proof order, the named budget, on the proof trial's design
